'''Football Club "Kalamata"''' ({{Langx|el|Ποδοσφαιρικός Σύλλογος «η Καλαμάτα»}}) is a Greek professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Kalamata]], [[Messenia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Εγγεγραμμένα σωματεία {{!}} Ηλεκτρονικό Μητρώο Αθλητικών Σωματείων με Ειδική Αθλητική Αναγνώριση |url=https://somateia2023.gga.gov.gr/eggegramena-somateia?eggegrammeno_2023=1&kodikos_gga=%CE%9A%CE%A029&name=%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%A6%CE%91%CE%99%CE%A1%CE%99%CE%9A%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%A3%CE%A5%CE%9B%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%97+%CE%9A%CE%91%CE%9B%CE%91%CE%9C%CE%91%CE%A4%CE%91&omospondia=82542&athlima=%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%A6%CE%91%CE%99%CE%A1%CE%9F&perifereia=%CE%A0%CE%95%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%9D%CE%9D%CE%97%CE%A3%CE%9F%CE%A5&perifereiaki_enotita=%CE%9C%CE%95%CE%A3%CE%A3%CE%97%CE%9D%CE%99%CE%91%CE%A3&dimos=%CE%9A%CE%91%CE%9B%CE%91%CE%9C%CE%91%CE%A4%CE%91%CE%A3&op=%CE%A6%CE%AF%CE%BB%CF%84%CF%81%CE%BF |access-date=2026-03-28 |website=somateia2023.gga.gov.gr}}</ref> They compete in the [[Super League Greece 2]], the second tier of the [[Greek football league system]]. The club's home ground is the [[Kalamata Metropolitan Stadium]]. From the 2026–27 season, the club will play in the [[Super League Greece]] after being promoted in the 2025–26 season, for the first time in 25 years."}}
